findings.title: Uncapped and excessive liquidated damages
findings.deviation: The clause imposes a 2% daily penalty on Total Fees without a cap, whereas the playbook allows only 0.5% per week on the affected milestone fee capped at 5%.
findings.impact: A short delay could result in penalties exceeding the entire contract value, and unlike the client contract, there is no exclusion for client-caused delays.
findings.quote: Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.
findings.counterPosition: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs where the delay is caused by the client; LDs are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
findings.linkedQuote: Client may claim a contractual penalty (Vertragsstrafe) of 0.5% of the Milestone Fee of the affected Milestone for each full week of delay, up to a maximum of 5% of that Milestone Fee.

findings.title: Prohibited pay-when-paid clause
findings.deviation: Payment is contingent on AtliQ receiving funds from the End Client (pay-when-paid), which the playbook explicitly prohibits.
findings.impact: Vendor may not be paid for work performed if the End Client defaults or delays payment to AtliQ for unrelated reasons.
findings.quote: AtliQ's obligation to pay any invoice is conditional upon AtliQ's receipt of payment from the End Client for the corresponding services. AtliQ shall pay each properly submitted, undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days after AtliQ receives the corresponding payment from the End Client
findings.counterPosition: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid.

findings.title: One-sided unlimited liability for vendor
findings.deviation: AtliQ's liability is capped at fees paid, but the vendor's liability is entirely unlimited for all losses.
findings.impact: The vendor faces unlimited financial exposure, making the contract commercially unviable and non-mutual under the mirror test.
findings.quote: NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT OR EXCLUDE VENDOR'S LIABILITY FOR ANY LOSSES, WHETHER DIRECT OR INDIRECT, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING VENDOR'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS.
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality.
findings.linkedQuote: liability shall be limited to the foreseeable damage typical for this type of contract, and in any event to the total remuneration under this Agreement.

findings.title: Indemnity covers AtliQ's own negligence
findings.deviation: The vendor is required to indemnify AtliQ even if the loss is caused by AtliQ's own negligence.
findings.impact: Vendor could be held liable for losses that were actually caused by AtliQ's faults or omissions.
findings.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless AtliQ... from and against any and all Losses... regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence.
findings.linkedQuote: Each Party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims resulting from its culpable breach of this Agreement.

findings.title: Failure to assign IP rights
findings.deviation: The vendor retains all rights (7.2) and only grants a non-exclusive license (7.3), whereas the client contract (6.5) requires AtliQ to transfer exclusive rights.
findings.impact: AtliQ will be in breach of the Rheinwerk contract because it cannot transfer 'exclusive' rights that it does not own.
findings.quote: Vendor shall retain all right, title and interest in and to... Deliverables... Vendor grants AtliQ a non-exclusive, non-transferable, perpetual licence
findings.counterPosition: Contractor assigns all rights in the work product to AtliQ; pre-existing materials are licensed on terms that let AtliQ pass to the client what the client contract requires.
findings.linkedQuote: Client shall acquire the exclusive, perpetual, transferable and unrestricted right of use in all Work Results created specifically for Client, upon full payment

findings.title: Missing mandatory data protection flow-down
findings.deviation: The agreement contains no DPA or GDPR-compliant sub-processing terms despite the scope involving personal data (technician names).
findings.impact: AtliQ is in breach of Section 13.1 of the Rheinwerk contract which mandates a Data Processing Agreement for any sub-processing.
findings.quote: Source data comprises... technician names, shift identifiers and free-text notes
findings.counterPosition: Execute the DPA/BAA and the sub-agreements first; ensure personnel are bound by data secrecy.
findings.linkedQuote: the Parties shall conclude the Data Processing Agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR attached as Annex 3

findings.title: No payment for WIP on convenience termination
findings.deviation: AtliQ refuses to pay for work in progress (WIP) upon termination for convenience.
findings.impact: The vendor loses the value of all work performed since the last accepted milestone, which is an unfair mirror-test deviation.
findings.quote: AtliQ's sole obligation shall be to pay Fees for Deliverables accepted by AtliQ prior to the effective date of termination; AtliQ shall have no obligation to pay for work in progress
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs.
findings.linkedQuote: Supplier shall be entitled to the agreed remuneration for services rendered plus compensation for committed costs.

findings.title: Non-mutual confidentiality definition
findings.deviation: Confidential Information is defined only as information disclosed by AtliQ or the End Client.
findings.impact: Vendor's own confidential information or trade secrets (like their labeling platform details) are not protected under this agreement.
findings.quote: “Confidential Information” means all non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of AtliQ or the End Client
findings.counterPosition: Make the definitions and obligations mutual.
findings.linkedQuote: The Parties shall keep confidential all business and trade secrets of the other Party

findings.title: No deemed acceptance mechanism
findings.deviation: The clause explicitly excludes acceptance by the passage of time, whereas the client contract allows for deemed acceptance.
findings.impact: AtliQ could indefinitely delay payment by failing to formally accept a deliverable, creating a risk AtliQ would not accept from a client.
findings.quote: Acceptance shall not be deemed to occur by... the passage of time.
findings.counterPosition: Include a deemed acceptance clause (e.g., 10 business days if no material defects are notified).
findings.linkedQuote: If Client fails to declare acceptance or to specify material defects within the period... acceptance shall be deemed to have been granted.

findings.title: Failure to acknowledge client consent
findings.deviation: The agreement does not reference the requirement for Rheinwerk's prior written consent for this subcontract.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks being in breach of the main agreement if it engages Kriti before obtaining Rheinwerk's formal approval.
findings.quote: Vendor shall not subcontract any portion of the Services without AtliQ's prior written consent.
findings.counterPosition: Ensure AtliQ obtains and documents Rheinwerk's consent before Vendor commences work.
findings.linkedQuote: Supplier may subcontract parts of the services only with Client's prior written consent.

fine.note: Indian law and Pune jurisdiction correctly match the AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd entity.
Standard professional services and IP warranties provided.
